description: This is a Java source file defining the HibernateUtil class, which contains utility methods for Hibernate ORM operations such as dialect detection, SQL escaping, proxy unproxying, and database queries within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HibernateUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing common Hibernate-related functions such as dialect detection, SQL escaping, and query helpers.

methods.name: isHSQLDialect
methods.description: Checks whether the current dialect is HSQL and caches the result.

methods.name: isPostgreSQLDialect
methods.description: Checks whether the current dialect is PostgreSQL and caches the result.

methods.name: getDialect
methods.description: Retrieves the dialect from the Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: escapeSqlWildcards
methods.description: Escapes SQL wildcards in a string for safe querying.

methods.name: getAttributePredicate
methods.description: Constructs predicates for attribute value criteria in JPA criteria queries.

methods.name: getRealObjectFromProxy
methods.description: Unwraps Hibernate proxies to get the real entity object.

methods.name: getUniqueEntityByUUID
methods.description: Retrieves a unique entity by UUID.

methods.name: getScrollableResult
methods.description: Creates a scrollable result set for batch processing.
